SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS week_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS gross_sales,
  SUM(COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0)) AS returns,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0)) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id AND d.calendar_date = frl.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_week

WITH sales_by_week AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS sales_amount,
    0 AS returns_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
),
returns_by_week AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    0 AS sales_amount,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) AS returns_amount
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON frl.return_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.fiscal_year, r.fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year,
  COALESCE(s.fiscal_week, r.fiscal_week) AS fiscal_week,
  SUM(s.sales_amount) - SUM(r.returns_amount) AS net_sales
FROM sales_by_week s
FULL OUTER JOIN returns_by_week r 
  ON s.fiscal_year = r.fiscal_year AND s.fiscal_week = r.fiscal_week
GROUP BY COALESCE(s.fiscal_year, r.fiscal_year), COALESCE(s.fiscal_week, r.fiscal_week)
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_week

WITH sales_data AS (
  WITH sales_by_week AS (
    SELECT 
      d.fiscal_year,
      d.fiscal_week,
      SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS sales_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line fsl
    INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 
      AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
  ),
  returns_by_week AS (
    SELECT 
      d.fiscal_year,
      d.fiscal_week,
      SUM(frl.refund_net) AS returns_amount
    FROM fact_return_line frl
    INNER JOIN dim_date d ON frl.return_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8 
      AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
  )
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(s.fiscal_year, r.fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year,
    COALESCE(s.fiscal_week, r.fiscal_week) AS fiscal_week,
    COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales_by_week s
  FULL OUTER JOIN returns_by_week r 
    ON s.fiscal_year = r.fiscal_year AND s.fiscal_week = r.fiscal_week
)
SELECT 
  this_year.fiscal_week AS week,
  this_year.net_sales AS sales_fy2026_27,
  last_year.net_sales AS sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND((this_year.net_sales - last_year.net_sales) / last_year.net_sales * 100, 1) AS growth_percent
FROM sales_data this_year
LEFT JOIN sales_data last_year 
  ON this_year.fiscal_week = last_year.fiscal_week 
  AND this_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND last_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE this_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY this_year.fiscal_week
